stages.title: SĀṂKHYA: CORE DISTINCTIONS
stages.terms: Exam use. ⚠️ This epistemology is the hinge of the whole system: because mūla-prakṛti (root Prakṛti) and puruṣa are not sense-objects, Sāṃkhya must show how they can still be known without multiplying pramāṇas.
stages.mechanism: Master verdict: Sāṃkhya is a realist dualism and evolutionism: Prakṛti transforms, Puruṣa witnesses, and liberation occurs through discriminating their radical difference.
stages.consequence: Exam use. ⚠️ This epistemology is the hinge of the whole system: because mūla-prakṛti (root Prakṛti) and puruṣa are not sense-objects, Sāṃkhya must show how they can still be known without multiplying pramāṇas.
stages.trap: Conclusion. ⚠️ Therefore the five arguments for Prakṛti and the arguments for Puruṣa are not rhetorical flourishes; they discharge an epistemological obligation created by Sāṃkhya's own three-pramāṇa scheme.
stages.answer: “Sāṃkhya (the enumerative dualist school) is a realist dualism in which three pramāṇas (means of valid knowledge) establish one unconscious Prakṛti (primordial material nature) and many conscious Puruṣas (pure witnesses).”.
